sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
sourceChecks.previousContext: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
sourceChecks.nextContext: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
sourceChecks.previousContext: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
sourceChecks.previousContext: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

sourceChecks.sourceText: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
sourceChecks.previousContext: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
sourceChecks.nextContext: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

sourceChecks.sourceText: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
sourceChecks.previousContext: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
sourceChecks.nextContext: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

sourceChecks.sourceText: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
sourceChecks.previousContext: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
sourceChecks.nextContext: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

sourceChecks.sourceText: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
sourceChecks.previousContext: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;
sourceChecks.nextContext: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

sourceChecks.sourceText: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
sourceChecks.previousContext: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
sourceChecks.nextContext: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

sourceChecks.sourceText: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
sourceChecks.previousContext: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
sourceChecks.nextContext: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
sourceChecks.previousContext: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
